summary: Tested new Admin Topic Editor + mock email integration. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All flows working (list, filters, search, editor, save draft, back). Stats confirmed: 340 total, 10 published, 330 drafts.
passed_tests: POST /api/contact returns 200 with mock email (RESEND_API_KEY empty -> mocked)
GET /api/curriculum/admin/topics-stats requires auth; returns total=340, published=10, draft=330, boards[], subjects[]
GET /api/curriculum/admin/topics (no auth) -> 401/403
GET /api/curriculum/admin/topics returns paginated list (topics, total, page, limit); content excluded from list items
Filter status=published -> total=10, all items published
Filter status=draft -> total=330, all items draft
Filter board=igcse works
Combined filters board+subject work
Search q=isotopes returns matching topics
Pagination page=1 vs page=2 returns disjoint item sets
GET /api/curriculum/admin/topics/{id} returns full topic with content; _id excluded, id included
Invalid topic id -> 404
PUT /api/curriculum/admin/topics/{id} updates fields; GET confirms persistence (seo_title, study_time)
PUT /api/curriculum/admin/topics/{id}/publish toggles status both directions
Admin login cookie session works for all admin endpoints
Admin Panel Topics tab shows stats (340/10/330) and topic list table
Search input filters topic list in realtime
Board filter (igcse) reduces list to IGCSE topics
Board+Status filter (igcse+published) shows 10 items
Clicking a topic row opens TopicForm with title, SEO title, meta description pre-populated
All 8 collapsible sections render: Topic Meta, Main Content, Definitions, Formulas, Worked Examples, Examiner Tips, Common Mistakes, Summary
Save Draft button triggers PUT /admin/topics/{id} and shows 'Topic saved' toast
Back button returns to topic list view
critical_code_review_comments: Backend admin topics endpoints use get_admin_user(request) correctly with cookie-based auth.
TopicEditor.js is 618 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting TopicList, TopicForm, Section, ListEditor to separate files for maintainability.
Backend update_topic uses model_dump() + None filter which is safe. MongoDB _id correctly excluded from responses.

Test data side-effect: our update test left seo_title='TEST_SEO_TITLE_EDIT' and study_time='45 min' on one draft topic (A-Level/Biology/Classification). Not a production concern but main agent may want to add a teardown or reset in seed. This is a test-only artifact.
Email service properly falls back to mock mode when RESEND_API_KEY empty; logs include to/subject for verification.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test leaves one draft topic (Classification) with modified seo_title='TEST_SEO_TITLE_EDIT' and study_time='45 min' — harmless, but main agent can reset via admin UI if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New admin topic management system works end-to-end. Email notifications are in MOCK mode (no RESEND_API_KEY) - mock returns {id: 'mock', status: 'mocked'}. All admin endpoints require cookie-based auth via admin@edvnova.com / Admin@123. 10 topics with SAMPLE_CONTENT are published, 330 are drafts. When RESEND_API_KEY is set, real email sending will kick in via resend.Emails.send.

mocked_apis_list: Resend email service: MOCKED when RESEND_API_KEY env var is empty. send_email() returns {id: 'mock', status: 'mocked'} and logs [MOCK EMAIL] to server logs instead of actually sending. Affects /api/contact and /api/orders/create notification flows.
